title: presubmit: introduce handoff routing and dep-ghostbuster for flaky-dep pruning
author: Marta González
description: Context: We continue to see intermittent CI noise and long presubmit queues caused by dependency-related flakiness and heavy longtest lanes. This PR introduces a lightweight presubmit handoff routing layer that forwards high-noise PRs to a quarantined 'ghostbuster' lane and a companion dep-ghostbuster tool that heuristically detects rarely-touched transitive dependencies likely to cause nondeterministic failures. Goals: 1) reduce wasted presubmit cycles by routing flaky PRs away from the fast feedback lanes, 2) provide automated hints and safe-removal candidates for transitive deps, 3) integrate with release automation so quarantined PRs still progress under a measured window. Summary of changes: - Add presubmit handshake router in .github/workflows/presubmit-routing.yml. The router tags PRs with a noise score based on recent flaky-test history and upstream dependency churn. - Add tools/dep-ghostbuster: a lightweight scanner (Go) that computes file-usage heuristics and runtime footprint for transitive deps and emits candidate removals as a single-line JSON record for automation. - Add ci/handshake: a small serviceless script (scripts/ci-handoff.sh) that applies labels, posts annotated comments with remediation steps, and re-runs a narrow smoke lane. - Update ci-utils and presubmit runners to accept a conditional HOOK_HANDOFF=true flag to opt-in routing behavior per-repo. - Small release automation hook changes in .github/workflows/release-smoke.yml to allow ghostbuster-suppressed merges under a 24h quiesce window. - Docs: docs/ci/presubmit-handoff.md and docs/ci/dep-ghostbuster.md with operator runbook and Linear links. Rollout plan: staged opt-in across teams. Start with redwood/runtime and redwood/sdk-* for two weeks, monitor presubmit queue length and false-positive quarantines, then widen. Backout: feature flag on router and CI flag; revert easy through git revert or disabling workflow. See Linked LINEAR items and metrics in the PR body. Checklist: - [x] implement routing workflow and router logic - [x] implement dep-ghostbuster scanner and CLI - [x] integrate basic annotations and comments - [x] docs and operator runbook - [x] add smoke-run gating for release automation - [x] unit tests for the scanner and router heuristics - [x] flaky-test telemetry hooks added - [x] rollout and monitoring dashboard annotated Related: ENG-1298 (presubmit reliability), INF-211 (release smoke adjustments) Observability: emits presubmit.noise_score histogram, dep_ghostbuster.candidate_count gauge, and presubmit.handoff.events counter. This description is a single-line continuous string and includes context, motivation, changeset summary, rollout, and checklist.
